items.item: 1. 07 §4.11 'What holds once time is in' (07:686), J3's frame words
items.how: 'holds in time in one form, restricted to what comes after:' -> 'holds in time in two forms, each asking only of later steps:'; the rest of the paragraph unchanged. Checked against ConditionInTime.lean: UnrestrictedEventually (forall p g, exists T, forall t >= T, sig p t g; T can always be taken later than the standpoint's step) and UnrestrictedAfter (forall p t g, step p < t -> sig p t g), with Flow.unrestrictedEventually_iff_mutuallyDependentInTime (from some step on = mutual dependence in time, from every step) and Flow.unrestrictedAfter_iff_coupledEachStep (every later step = at every step each formation equal to or affecting every other at the next); UnrestrictedAfter.eventually gives the one from the other, so 'which is stronger' stands. No live quoter.

571: 'where relations close, read across all steps, a self-concerned order already ranks' -> 'where relations of being affected close, read across all steps, a self-concerned order already ranks'; 982: 'Where relations close, read across all steps, a self-concerned order already ranks' -> 'Where relations of being affected close, read across all steps, a self-concerned order already ranks'. Both cite §4's r-self-concern-and-c-under-the-condition, whose theorem (Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn, PremiseWitnesses.lean:531) takes Unrestricted (selfAscribed (ownClosure rel) center) for any relation rel on formations; the condition 'where relations close' is given by Flow.MutuallyDependent.unrestricted, whose significance is own closure under L.AffectedBy (being affected, FlowCenters.lean:141-152), as 07:5 already says ('So read along being affected, it holds where relations close, read across all steps'). The composite is not one theorem (07:5 says so). No live quoter of either sentence.

392: 'what holding one's own continuation does where nothing lies outside it.' -> 'what self-concern does where nothing lies outside it.'; 395: 'one order in two forms, holding one's own continuation and C.' -> 'one requirement on an order in two forms, self-concern and C.' (RoutesToC.lean:222-229, Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_comparison: where every listed item is marked an order is self-concerned exactly when it meets C on the listing's frame; the docstring's 'One premise in two forms'). Crosswalk followed: cx-sspiral-regenerative-interdependence targets[3].says, cx-kpso-open-is-not-c targets[5].says, cx-kpso-questioner-on-the-bridge targets[5].says ('one requirement on an order in two forms, self-concern and C') and that entry's account_adds ('they are one order in two forms' -> 'they are one requirement on an order in two forms'). PHILOSOPHY.md:354 quotes 392 (in left).

'and C then ranks it higher' -> 'and an order meeting C then ranks it higher' (Ranking.restraint_ranks_stepwise, JointDraw.lean:248: 'Every comparison satisfying C under the stepwise reading then ranks the restrained course higher'). No live quoter (atlas.json, the crosswalk pages and map.html are generated).

07: 'where C alone leaves them unranked' -> 'where C asks nothing of them' (Ranking.stepwise_unranked and Ranking.relational_unranked: neither course extends the other under those readings once the focal formation has an included event, so C, which asks a ranking only of extensions, asks nothing of the pair). Record: statement.en ', where C alone leaves them unranked.' -> ', where C asks nothing of them.'; laws[2].en ', where C alone leaves the two unranked.' -> ', where C asks nothing of the two.'; statement.zh and laws[2].zh '，那里 C 单独不对两者排序。' -> '，那里 C 对两者无所要求。' (what-would-give-c's 'C 对它无所要求'); a history entry in both languages. Ten crosswalk entries: the seven says quoting 07:784 (cx-archearth-provision-apart-from-membership t0, cx-kpso-protective-closure t4, cx-ma-cancer-levels t2, cx-wamo-floor-and-exit t0, cx-zhishan-not-a-master-good t5, cx-zhishan-irreversible-closure-priority t0, cx-abr-maqasid-tiers t0) now end 'where C asks nothing of them.'; the three readings saying 'C alone leaves mixed comparisons undecided' (cx-asc-tempo-measurement-replaces-values, cx-zhishan-irreversible-closure-priority, cx-econ-arrow-sen-impossibility) now say 'C asks nothing of mixed comparisons'.

Re-said: '(the continuation condition, an order ranking by widening and the practical commitments; an argument)' -> '(the continuation condition, a self-concerned order or one meeting C, and the practical commitments; an argument)'. Why: the endorsement cites no theorem; it is an argument (its study, history/ALIGNMENT-THROUGH-CHANGE.md, appraised under living significance, a direction 'compared by widening' and the practical commitments). In 07 an order ranks by widening only as one of the two hypotheses the theorems take: self-concern where the condition, read across all steps, holds de se (Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn, Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_of_unrestricted), or an order meeting C (Comparison, every claim living, Web.paths_extension_iff_widens); 07:5 says each ranking result names 'the continuation condition, self-concern, or Comparison'. 'An order ranking by widening' named neither and read as an order premise beside the condition, the frame message 10 withdrew. 07:1002's 'an order ranking by widening or the step of invariance' (does-not-show) is kept, as the critic said: no one must hold such an order. Crosswalk followed: the four says quoting the label (cx-asc-ends-are-output-of-the-game t1, cx-kpso-self-freezing t2, cx-rsd-shaping-legitimacy t3, cx-sty-consent-door t2) and the reading of cx-sspiral-human-nature ('conditionally (the continuation condition, a self-concerned order or one meeting C, and the practical commitments)').

'The condition alone ranks nothing. Where it holds de se, self-concern does what C asks between two level paths' -> 'The condition alone ranks nothing. Where the condition, read across all steps, holds de se, self-concern does what C asks between two level paths', as 07:5 says it.

statement.en (300 of 300; style.STATEMENT_CAP (300, 150), a hard cap): 'At formations returning along affecting, each under its least class, the de se condition is exactly mutual dependence; they count nothing beyond their coupling closures; orders persisting choices allow meet C on listed paths met; under activity, support and descent, the course taken is never listed.' To make room: 'whose acts return' -> 'returning'; 'given one' (one returning formation) left to laws[0] and hypotheses[1], which carry it (the critic's example); 'nothing beyond their coupling closures counts from them' -> 'they count nothing beyond their coupling closures'; 'give what C asks' -> 'meet C'. The hypotheses are Flow.persists_not_listsAdmitted's (acting, dependent, descended, with persists). zh (98 chars): '（有其一时）' dropped likewise, '在活动、支撑与传承之下，所取之程从不被列出。' (传承 for Descended). validation_scope: 'entails the condition, which does not limit other accounts' -> 'entails the condition, and that theorem does not limit other accounts' (570 of 600); zh '此不限其他' -> '此定理不限其他'. A history entry in both languages. style.lint: 0 findings before and after.

items.item: 9. The Lean package README: rows for Becoming.FromTheDynamics and Becoming.FallibleInquiry
items.how: FromTheDynamics: an L2 row after ReadingsPersist (after all five of its imports), from its header and theorems and as 07 §4.13 says it: near-definitional, own closure adopted as significance, the connection and survivor results composed, ReadsOnlyDynamics.not_entails 'a theorem that does not limit other accounts'; the scope (Flow.returning_downstream_iff_mutuallyDependent, given one returning formation), the bound (Flow.returning_beyond_coupling), what the orders allowed give of C with its hypotheses (ChoiceOccasions.selfConcerned_above_iff_reach, Web.extension_reached_of_met, one step of 'the shown relation with every own-widening met added'), the stake (Web.extension_met_keeps_above_ending), 'the finite-listing route does not cover the course taken' under only active formations giving, activity needing support and descent (Flow.persists_not_listsAdmitted), self-concern on every pair not following (Alternating.crossed_joined), the joint witness (Alternating.joined); readings and nothing in time. FallibleInquiry is in no layer (not in the checker's core list; imports ScientificInquiryNecessity), so its row is labelled Periphery and placed after the last Application row, outside layers.py's row block (its ROW pattern matches only base/L*/Instance/Application, and --write keeps lines after the block): the answer-alike laws, common unaccounted change in place of balance, the weighted and timed bounds, the witnesses, 'a necessary bound, not a sufficient condition for knowledge', checked by check_fallible_inquiry.py. Also the RoutesToC row's title 'what would give C's order on a listing' -> 'what would give an order meeting C on a listing' (07:395's title, below). layers.py (plain run): README.md 394 rows, 0 labels other than computed, 0 modules without a row (before: FromTheDynamics without one).

Searched with rg the live tree for each old 07 phrase (chapters, fronts, dossiers, GLOSSARY*, MAP, records' current fields, data, atlas entries, goals, tools and tests), leaving out sources, history, _process/research dated studies, becoming-checks receipts and generated pages. Fixed in my files: the 16 crosswalk fields above and correspondence_groups.json's two 'what' fields naming 07:395's section ('What would give C's order on a listing' -> 'What would give an order meeting C on a listing'). The rest are in left. No test pins any sentence I changed (grep of tools/research/tests).
